name: dogfood-nextjs-server-action-app
description: Dogfood app v1.34-3 — a Next.js 15.4 + React 19.1 App Router app that drives Server Action + form action + useFormStatus + useOptimistic + revalidatePath + revalidateTag + redirect + progressive enhancement across a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa-lab/component v0.3 form-action-advanced semantics + @kiwa-lab/nextjs v1.2 server-action-advanced semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Playwright + Chromium headless when SERVER_ACTION_BROWSER_READY=1) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory session harness) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/component -F @kiwa-lab/core -F @kiwa-lab/nextjs -F @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
